title: Agent Court
summary: Lock SPL tokens between two agents, file a dispute, render a Release verdict, and claim the payout to agent_b.
what: Agent Court is an Anchor 0.32.1 escrow used with an off-chain judge. deposit writes a PDA (seeds ["escrow", agent_a, agent_b, service_hash]) and a vault ATA. Either agent can file_dispute. render_verdict records Release, Refund, or Split. claim then pays according to the verdict and can close the vault.
app_note: The page at /dapps/agent-court/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/agent-court. The lab only changed declare_id to a unique lab program.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/agent-court/, switch to Devnet, and connect a wallet. The lab already ran deposit, file_dispute, render_verdict(Release) and claim for 1_000_000 lab tokens.

diagram: agent_a --deposit--> escrow+vault; either agent --file_dispute--> Disputed; judge --render_verdict(Release)--> Resolved; claimer --claim--> agent_b ATA.
accounts: escrow PDA seeds ["escrow", agent_a, agent_b, service_hash]
vault PDA seeds ["vault", escrow] (token authority = escrow)
innovation: The on-chain program stores evidence hashes and a verdict; release/refund/split math runs in claim. timeout_release pays agent_b if no dispute is filed before timeout_at.
exercises: Derive the escrow PDA and confirm it matches 4JGCYPoe….
What status must the escrow be in before claim?
not_covered: The off-chain judge services in the upstream repo
objectives: Deposit SPL tokens into a two-agent escrow PDA.
Explain how a Release verdict unlocks a claim.
Locate the claim transaction and name who received funds.
prereqs: A Devnet wallet with practice funds and the lesson mint.
Understanding of escrow authorities and dispute outcomes.
student_outcome: Deposit into Agent Court, follow a Release verdict, and verify the payout claim.

learning_loop.objective: Trace deposit → dispute → Release verdict → claim — then state required escrow status before claim.
learning_loop.predict_question: A Release verdict has been rendered. What must be true before claim succeeds?

predict_options.label: Claim works from any escrow status
Escrow must be in the post-verdict status that unlocks claim (Release path)
Only deposit matters; verdict is optional

learning_loop.predict_why: Agent Court unlocks claim after a Release verdict puts the escrow in the claimable status. Deposit alone is not enough.
learning_loop.act: Open /dapps/agent-court/ on Devnet. Prefer recorded deposit → file dispute → Release verdict → claim proofs. Derive escrow PDA and confirm it matches the lab address.
learning_loop.explain_question: Why must claim check escrow status rather than trusting that a dispute was filed?
learning_loop.transfer: Name one verdict path this lesson exercised (Release) and one not exercised (Split/Refund/timeout).

assessment.purpose: Independent elective criteria; no Picassol leakage.

criteria.title: Derives escrow PDA
criteria.question: Can the student derive/match the lab escrow PDA?

criteria.title: States claim precondition
criteria.question: Can the student name required status after Release?

criteria.title: Evidence honesty
criteria.question: Routes labelled?
criteria.misconception: Lab claim is my wallet payout.
